title: Archimedean realisation of the direct limit algebra
html: In the archimedean realisation (\mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe), applying the fibre functor \tau to the direct limit algebra yields \mathcal{A}_\infty \cong \varinjlim\Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)).
